recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. The current source matches FHIR-21272's requested wording and preserves FHIR-32987's non-practitioner clarification.
issue_request: FHIR-21272 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked the Task intent "order" definition to change from "by a Practitioner" to "by the requestor" because requestors can be Practitioners, Organizations, Devices, Patients, and other actors.
initial_application: Git 4dfb8eaf70 changed source/request/codesystem-request-intent.xml and the then-present manual source/task/valueset-task-intent.xml narrative to "by the requestor". Git bad797e207/PR #2409 then synchronized source/request/request-spreadsheet.xml and deleted the manual Task ValueSet narrative so the generated expansion could use the CodeSystem definition.
additional_context: FHIR-32987 had earlier changed the same CodeSystem definition to remove the Practitioner-specific actor. A September 2022 Zulip committers thread documented that the CodeSystem source was corrected but build/ValueSet pages still showed stale text because of manual narrative; that is the problem PR #2409 cleaned up.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source change was made because the current CodeSystem and request spreadsheet both say "by the requestor", Task's active ValueSet composes the request-intent code system and has no manual narrative override, and active request/task sources no longer contain the Practitioner wording.

related_jiras.note: Earlier Published/Persuasive issue on the same Task/order intent text removed the Practitioner-specific wording before FHIR-21272 refined it to "by the requestor".
